alex: Quick perf note — KV-cache heavy tails on A100 when seq_len > 1024, seeing throughput drop ~18% vs baseline. profile snippet below.

shreyas: can you paste the flamegraph or top hotspots?

alex: flamegraph shows hot path in `kv_lookup_kernel` and long stalls in `smem_prefetch` when occupancy is high. snippet:
```
kv_lookup_kernel  42.7%  stall: mem-bound
smem_prefetch     21.3%  stall: shared-mem bank conflicts
other             36.0%
```

marta: hmm — are we hitting register spilling? what's register usage per-thread?

alex: register usage bumped from 64->86 regs/thread on that build (opt-level change), occupancy dropped from 0.75->0.5. config: `tile=32` `warpspecialize=on` `kv_prefetch=2`

liu: could try reducing tile to 16 or enabling warp-split path for long seqs. tradeoff: more kernel launches vs better occupancy.

nate: also verify kernel selection logic: we currently pick smem-heavy kernel if seq_len>256 regardless of regs. maybe add arch-aware guard for regs/occupancy.

shreyas: agreed. proposal: autotuner do two probes per arch: (1) tile=32 path, (2) tile=16 path and pick by tokens/s. fallback if latency > SLO.

marta: +1. add a metric for shared-mem bank-conflict rate into profiler so autotuner can avoid the smem-heavy kernel on A100 when register pressure is high.

perf-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/auto-tile-probes -> staging at 2026-03-16T17:02:00Z :rocket:

alex: I'll open a PR with the probe harness and a perf run on p4d and a100. tagging @shreyas @marta for review :thumbsup:
